website.note: Marketing site mentions anxiety / insomnia indications and the Nexalin device family; no dedicated /pipeline page (404). Marketing content does not list NCT IDs or trial phases.

ctgov.note: No active P1/P2/P3 trials with Nexalin Technology as lead sponsor.

marketed_devices.name: Gen-1 Nexalin device (cranial electrotherapy stimulation)
marketed_devices.indication: Anxiety and insomnia (Class II) and depression (Class III post Dec 2019 FDA reclassification of CES devices)

in_development_devices.name: Gen-2 Console / Gen-2 SYNC (transcranial alternating current stimulation, tACS)
in_development_devices.indication: Alzheimer's disease, dementia, mild cognitive impairment (MCI)
in_development_devices.status: FDA Q-Submission accepted October 2025; FDA meeting held November 2025; protocol/strategy under development; no IND/IDE granted, no NCT ID, no active US clinical study yet. Hong Kong joint venture with Wider for Gen-2 commercialization in China.

in_development_devices.name: Gen-3 HALO headset
in_development_devices.status: Pre-submission consultations with FDA ongoing; planned future US clinical trials. No active trial.

excluded_preclinical.reason: FDA Q-Sub stage only; no IDE-authorized clinical study yet (planned, not started).
FDA pre-submission stage; no IDE-authorized clinical study yet (planned, not started).

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Medical device (neurostimulation) company. Gen-1 device is already FDA-cleared and marketed for anxiety/insomnia (Class II) and depression (Class III). Next-generation Gen-2 SYNC (Alzheimer's/dementia/MCI) and Gen-3 HALO (mental health) are still in pre-submission / Q-Submission interactions with the FDA - no IDE-authorized pivotal clinical studies are active and no trials are listed on ClinicalTrials.gov.
